# Regulations.gov synthetic fixtures

These JSON files are privacy-safe synthetic fixtures reconstructed from the
official Regulations.gov API v4 JSON:API shapes and field documentation. They
are not copied provider responses and contain no real API key, submitter, public
comment, attachment, or user data.

References reviewed on 2026-08-31:

- https://open.gsa.gov/api/regulationsgov/
- https://open.gsa.gov/api/regulationsgov/v4/openapi.yaml
- https://api.data.gov/docs/rate-limits/
